title: Designing Service Systems from Textual Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2601.21471v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In service system design, it is often the case that the main evidence of system performance appears in textual form, such as customer support transcripts, complaint narratives, and compliance review reports. With the increasing use of large language models (LLMs), these textual trajectories can be converted into low-cost proxy scores that support comparison and optimization of candidate service configurations. However, LLM-based evaluations can exhibit systematic bias and require human audits for correction. To this end, this research studies how to identify the best service configuration with high confidence while minimizing the use of expensive human audits. We formulate the problem as fixed-confidence best arm identification with an always-observed, potentially biased proxy and selectively acquired human-verified outcomes. translated_title: 基于文本证据的服务系统设计
translated_abstract: 在服务系统设计中，系统性能的主要证据往往以文本形式呈现，例如客户支持对话记录、投诉叙述和合规审查报告。随着大语言模型（LLM）的日益广泛应用，这些文本轨迹可以被转化为低成本的代理评分，从而支持对候选服务配置的比较和优化。然而，基于大语言模型的评估可能存在系统性偏差，需要通过人工审计进行纠正。为此，本研究探讨如何在最小化昂贵人工审计使用量的同时，以高置信度识别出最佳的服务配置。我们将该问题形式化为固定置信度下的最佳臂识别问题，其中包含始终可观测但可能存在偏差的代理评分，以及有选择性获取的人工验证结果。此外，多个服务配置可以在同一案例上运行。人工审计可以提供案例标签……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究将基于文本证据的服务系统设计问题形式化为固定置信度下的最佳臂识别问题，利用大语言模型生成的低成本代理评分并结合有选择性的人工审计来校正偏差，从而以最小的人工审计成本高置信度地识别出最优服务配置。
en_tdlr: This research formulates service system design from textual evidence as a fixed-confidence best arm identification problem, combining LLM-derived proxy scores with selectively acquired human audits to confidently identify the best service configuration while minimizing costly human verification.
